text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 54-56 पर नाटक ‘The Cobbler and the Fairies’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 54-56 par naatak ‘The Cobbler and the Fairies’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the play ‘The Cobbler and the Fairies’ on pages 54–56 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: True or false? Denu was a washerman.
True or false? The fairies made the shoes.
True or false? Dhania sewed clothes for the fairies.

questionMeaning.hi: धनिया ने परियों के लिए कपड़े सिले।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dhania ne pariyon ke liye kapde sile.

steps.question: True or false? Denu made clothes for the fairies.

questionMeaning.hi: देनू ने परियों के लिए कपड़े बनाए।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Denu ne pariyon ke liye kapde banaaye.

steps.question: True or false? Dhania said that God will help them.

questionMeaning.hi: धनिया ने कहा कि भगवान मदद करेंगे।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dhania ne kaha ki Bhagwaan madad karenge.

steps.question: Why was Denu worried?
options: It was his last piece of leather and he had no money.
steps.answer: It was his last piece of leather and he had no money.
steps.modelAnswer: Denu was worried because it was his last piece of leather and he had no money to buy more. He feared they would have no food.

modelMeaning.hi: देनू परेशान था क्योंकि आख़िरी चमड़ा बचा था और और ख़रीदने के पैसे नहीं थे। उसे डर था कि खाना नहीं मिलेगा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Denu pareshaan tha kyonki aakhiri chamda bacha tha aur aur khareedne ke paise nahi the. Use dar tha ki khaana nahi milega.

steps.question: What did Denu find in his workshop next morning?

questionMeaning.hi: अगली सुबह देनू को काम की जगह पर क्या मिला?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Agli subah Denu ko kaam ki jagah par kya mila?

options: a new pair of shining shoes
steps.answer: a new pair of shining shoes
steps.modelAnswer: Next morning, Denu found a new pair of shoes shining bright in his workshop.

modelMeaning.hi: अगली सुबह देनू को अपनी जगह पर चमकते नए जूते मिले।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Agli subah Denu ko apni jagah par chamakte naye joote mile.

steps.question: What did Dhania make for the fairies?

questionMeaning.hi: धनिया ने परियों के लिए क्या बनाया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dhania ne pariyon ke liye kya banaaya?

steps.modelAnswer: Dhania made nice, bright and colourful clothes for the fairies.

modelMeaning.hi: धनिया ने परियों के लिए सुंदर रंग-बिरंगे कपड़े बनाए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Dhania ne pariyon ke liye sundar rang-birange kapde banaaye.

steps.question: How did Denu and Dhania find out who made the shoes?

questionMeaning.hi: देनू और धनिया को कैसे पता चला कि जूते कौन बनाता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Denu aur Dhania ko kaise pata chala ki joote kaun banaata hai?

options: They hid behind the door at night and watched.
steps.answer: They hid behind the door at night and watched.
steps.modelAnswer: They hid behind the door at night and saw five fairies come in and make the shoes.

modelMeaning.hi: उन्होंने रात को दरवाज़े के पीछे छिपकर देखा कि पाँच परियाँ आकर जूते बनाती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unhone raat ko darwaaze ke peechhe chhipkar dekha ki paanch pariyaan aakar joote banaati hain.

steps.question: What did the fairies do when they got new clothes?

questionMeaning.hi: नए कपड़े पाकर परियों ने क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Naye kapde paakar pariyon ne kya kiya?

options: They put them on happily and sang and danced all night.
steps.answer: They put them on happily and sang and danced all night.
steps.modelAnswer: The fairies put on the new clothes happily and sang and danced all night.

modelMeaning.hi: परियों ने ख़ुशी से नए कपड़े पहने और सारी रात नाचीं-गाईं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pariyon ne khushi se naye kapde pehne aur saari raat naachin-gaayin.
